question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's position as CCP General Secretary remains secure ahead of the 21st Party Congress in late 2027, where analysts anticipate formal endorsement of a fourth term extending his rule into the 2030s. Extensive anti-corruption purges of Politburo and military figures have eliminated potential rivals, while recent diplomatic engagements and policy initiatives demonstrate continued active leadership without visible internal challenges or health concerns. The absence of a designated successor and structural changes eliminating term limits further reinforce elite alignment around his continued tenure through 2026. Trader consensus at 95.5% for "No" reflects this entrenched control. Low-probability shifts could still arise from sudden health developments, major external crises triggering elite fractures, or unforeseen leadership disputes at the congress.

question: Will Gavin Newsom win the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination?
